title: Threshold Energy (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly calculate the laboratory threshold gamma-ray energy as 145 MeV.

title: Proton Energy (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must determine the minimum proton energy for pion photoproduction as approximately 6.8 x 10^13 MeV.

title: Invariant Mass Approach
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly apply the invariant mass concept to derive the threshold conditions for both parts (a) and (b).

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria - The student must demonstrate understanding of energy conservation principles in the context of the reactions described.

title: Cosmic Ray Implications
description: Optional Criteria - The student should provide a thoughtful speculation on the implications of the results for cosmic ray protons.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should avoid common errors in calculations, such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
